name: Konban Tomete Nya Ningen-san!!
original_name: 今晩泊めてにゃ人間さん！！
source:
One night, behind a convenience store, you encounter an alien with cat ears!?
Before you know it, they've forcibly moved into your home!
A strange and lively cohabitation begins.

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/tomenya.html]official website[/url]]
